title: Revised grounds open fresh hope
meaning: Your shared view can gain hope when changing conditions let you examine earlier grounds and see a new possibility for understanding.
text: Hope can appear after recognising that familiar grounds were incomplete. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Ajna suggests updating your view as conditions change. The Tower in energy supports wanting to check an earlier foundation’s reliability. The Star in emotions feels hope for new understanding. You may enjoy change revealing a previously unnoticed question. Your view gains room to examine grounds while preserving details already seen. Hope grows from a particular connection without having to regard a new explanation as final or uniquely possible beforehand.

For example, you examine a familiar drawing after a photograph of its edges becomes available. The composition previously seemed deliberately asymmetrical. **Revising grounds can open a hopeful possibility.** You update your view, noticing that the earlier image was cropped. A question now arises about the central pattern’s relationship with the margins. It feels pleasing to see substance still available for understanding. Your picture has expanded although individual details’ purposes remain unknown. New conditions let you examine an earlier account while preserving observations about the part first seen.

The risk is immediately declaring the full photograph an explanation of every feature because hope feels good. A discovered limit in the old account becomes excessive confidence in the new one. Wanting to examine grounds preserves openness: material has expanded while particular connections may remain unknown and need consideration of their own.
